notes: Route Travel Visualization: citizen tokens now move proportionally along known route lines using the same authoritative job progress shown on the citizen cards. A traveler at 60% job progress is rendered about 60% of the way from origin to destination instead of remaining visually pinned to the departure landmark. Traveling tokens also show a compact progress badge, while tooltip/accessible text includes destination and approximate route distance remaining. This is presentation-only and does not write interpolated positions back into Simulation.
